newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - More coffee gains seen difficult.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - More coffee gains seen difficult.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
The rally in LIFFE coffee futures is seen slowing down, making further gains difficult to sustain, technical analysts said.
July was expected to open unchanged.
Susan Rigg, analyst at Chart Analysis, said July looked "overstretched."
She noted that New York July coffee futures rallied and managed to close strongly at $1,477, just off its session high.
In contrast, London, which has lagged in the rally, accelerated to the upside but closed well off its highs.
Rigg said that quick move up in London followed by a mediocre close was often seen as a "trend-ending characteristic."

As a result, she expected London's July to slip back to fill a gap left between the May 16 low of $1,973 and the previous day's high of $1,940. Once that gap is filled, she said July could fall further to test support near $1,820 before consolidating.
"A move up will unlikely be sustained," Rigg said.
A U.S. analyst also expected a slight pull back in the near-term to correct a very overbought relative strength indicator before going higher again.
